    Eternal Paradise

    The Silo¶

    The base is built around a massive silo — a structure left behind by the Old Humans of the 157th Colony era, approximately three million years ago. The silo was designed to house a weapon of extraordinary power: a neutron bomb capable of triggering a global ice age.

    When the Shadows arrived on Ge'or in 2989 BGD, they did not know the silo existed. They discovered it approximately 597 years ago — around the time of the Great Divergence (Year 0). The malfunction of the Glorious Alliance reactor provided the energy signature that led them to it.

    The Shadows recovered the Glorious Alliance's reactor core — the same core whose malfunction created The Groom and caused the Kutten Catastrophe — and have been working ever since to integrate it with the silo. The neutron bomb is nearly complete.

    When activated, the Armageddon device will:

    • Trigger a global ice age — wiping out billions, collapsing every decentralized state.
    • Unleash the Pontus goblin army simultaneously.
    • Coincide with The Groom's final detonation.
    • Coincide with the Pontificate of Eris declaring the prophecy of Eris fulfilled.

    The Eternal Paradise Plan¶

    Eternal Paradise is not merely a base. It is the name of the Shadows' ultimate objective — their answer to the destruction of Old Earth and the imprisonment of the Hybrian hivemind in the Fortress Planet.

    The plan is simple. The Shadows will use their growing hold on the Hope Realm — the soul substrate of reality — to unleash a force that will consume the entire universe. All matter. All stars. All atoms. Everything will be converted into a single substance: black goo.

    This is the same substance that the Old Humans studied at the 157th Colony. The same substance that, in modified form, became the Black Agent — the DNA agent that created The Two Protagonists. The Shadows call it the "element of soul" — the raw material of consciousness itself, rendered liquid and controllable.

    In their final form, the universe will be:

    • A formless entity — no stars, no planets, no life, no matter in any recognizable state.
    • Perfectly controlled — everything inside the goo, nothing outside it.
    • Eternal — no death, no change, no freedom, no hope. Only the Hybrian consciousness, extending infinitely in all directions.

    This is what the Shadows have been working toward for 8,000 years — since the campfire on Old Earth. The nation-state was step one. The hivemind was step two. The universe-as-goo is the final step. Perfect control. No resistance. No existence outside their will.

    The Protagonist Connection¶

    The Black Agent that created the two protagonists is derived from this same goo — the element of soul. The Old Humans of the 157th Colony were studying it, trying to understand it, trying to weaponize it. The Shadows are trying to become it.

    The protagonists are not merely powerful mages. They carry within them the raw material of the Shadows' endgame — repurposed by the accumulated hope of quintillions of dead souls, aimed at the enemy that created it.

    Current Status (597 AGD)¶

    The neutron bomb is nearly complete. The Shadows' hold on the Hope Realm is growing. The Armageddon timeline is approaching.

    The base is heavily guarded. The island is remote. No one on Ge'or knows it exists — except the Ironcloak, who have fragments of intelligence they cannot fully verify.
